metadata.description: Make websites faster, better for SEO and easier to manage with Flipsite – including moving WordPress sites over.

plugins.name: flipsite
plugins.description: Make a slow WordPress (or any) website fast, SEO-friendly and easy to manage: /migrate-to-flipsite rebuilds it on Flipsite with high PageSpeed/Lighthouse scores, content in a CMS separate from layout and theme, every language and URL kept, and a before/after PageSpeed report. Also connects the Flipsite MCP server so Claude can build and edit Flipsite sites.
